provider: CUHK Department of English 2026-27 Major Programme Requirement and Course List
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2026-27 and thereafter
note: The official 2026-27 Major Programme Requirement publishes a 66-unit English Major: a 9-unit Faculty Package, 21 units of Required Courses and 36 units from any 12 of 49 Major Elective Courses. The Department's current Course List closes the codes, English titles and units for ENGE1000, all seven Required Courses and all 49 Major Elective options. ENGE4701 and ENGE4702 replace the legacy ENGE4700 in the current requirement and carry 1 and 5 units respectively. The optional Creative Writing Stream requires ENGE3260 and ENGE3290 plus four courses from a seven-course subset, totaling 18 units within the Major requirement. The Faculty Package additionally requires any two courses from an Arts Faculty list whose current page uses abbreviated cross-department codes and does not publish their titles; those two non-ENGE choices are not imported. The 57 verified ENGE courses therefore form a partial read-only planning list and must not be presented as the complete 66-unit graduation structure or produce a graduation completion percentage.
